content:
We're excited to share that Veil now has initial support for liveness proofs!

We've published the first post in a short series introducing this support:
https://proofsandintuitions.net/2026/06/24/liveness-proofs-in-veil-part-1/

More posts will follow with additional details about the design, examples, and how to use the new support.

This is still at an early stage, so there are likely bugs, rough edges, and missing pieces. We'd very much appreciate feedback from users who try it out, especially reports about usability issues, confusing behavior, or examples that do not work as expected.

The liveness proof is in the veil-live-demo branch but I've been using veil-2.0-preview. What is the relation between these two branches, e.g. if I switch to the veil-live-demo branch, is it compatible with veil-2.0-preview, or at least compatible with veil-2.0-preview from some recent checkpoint, etc.?
veil-live-demo is built on top of veil-2.0-preview with several more commits, so it should be compatible with veil-2.0-preview.
